mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bank_account ( bank_identity_id, bank_code, account_number, account_name, account_holder_name, balance, status ) VALUES ( #{bankIdentityId}, #{bankCode}, #{accountNumber}, #{accountName}, #{accountHolderName}, #{balance}, #{status} )
mapper.sql: account_id, bank_identity_id, bank_code, account_number, account_name, account_holder_name, balance, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT a.account_id, a.bank_identity_id, a.bank_code, a.account_number, a.account_name, a.account_holder_name, a.balance, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM bank_account a JOIN bank_identity i ON a.bank_identity_id = i.bank_identity_id WHERE i.user_key_hash = #{userKey} ORDER BY a.account_id ASC

SELECT a.account_id, a.bank_identity_id, a.bank_code, a.account_number, a.account_name, a.account_holder_name, a.balance, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at FROM bank_account a JOIN bank_identity i ON a.bank_identity_id = i.bank_identity_id WHERE i.user_key_hash = #{userKey}
SELECT i.user_key_hash FROM bank_account a JOIN bank_identity i ON a.bank_identity_id = i.bank_identity_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT a.account_id, a.bank_identity_id, a.bank_code, a.account_number, a.account_name, a.account_holder_name, a.balance, a.status, a.created_at, a.updated_at, i.user_key_hash AS owner_user_key_hash FROM bank_account a JOIN bank_identity i ON a.bank_identity_id = i.bank_identity_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}
